top_story.headline: Rep. Dan Crenshaw still has no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 66 days past his final extension
top_story.dek: The Deadline Watch check flags the Texas Republican as the one sitting member with no CY2025 annual report after every extension has run out.
paragraphs: Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed for an extension on 6/4/2026. His final extension date was 8/13/2026, and no calendar-year 2025 annual report was on file as of this edition, 66 days later. He is the only sitting member the check found in that position.

The check compares every sitting member against the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD. A filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can read as missing, so the finding rests on that index match.

Elsewhere the day is quiet. The OGE summary reports no new divestitures, terminations or ethics agreements. The scripts found no new FARA filings, House or Senate disclosures, or presidential and vice-presidential 278-Ts. The lda.gov API returned HTTP 503 during the run, so the lobbying checks are incomplete.

sections.headline: No new ethics filings this period
paragraphs: OGE filings received during the past three days contain no new divestitures, terminations, or ethics agreements. All filings in the window were previously reported.

sections.headline: Lobbying data was unavailable this run
paragraphs: The lda.gov API returned HTTP 503, so the day's registrations, terminations and activity reports could not be reviewed and nothing is reported here. The watched-industry and pardon-lobbying checks failed with the same error. LDA third-quarter LD-2 activity reports are due 10/20/2026, in 2 days.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.

footer.known_gaps: LDA HTTP 503: the day's lobbying filings could not be fetched. The watched-industry lobbying checks (prediction markets, crypto and digital assets, artificial intelligence, defense tech) and the pardon, clemency and commutation lobbying checks also failed with lda.gov HTTP 503, so their 'no new filings' results are unverified. The OGE summary listed no known gaps.
